description: Monitors spending against limits and provides compassionate interventions including notifications, cooling-off timers, and spending lock suggestions

result.message: Great job keeping track of your spending! You’ve used $150 out of your $200 shopping budget, which puts you at 75%. Let’s celebrate your mindful awareness, and together, we can keep an eye on your remaining budget. If you need ideas for no-cost or low-cost rewards, I’m here to help!
result.action_recommended: Pause and review your shopping list before any new purchases.
alternative_suggestions: Take a break and review your upcoming needs before buying more.
Consider window shopping or online browsing without purchasing to satisfy the urge.
